guidelines.fragment_description: A Use Case represents a functionality or service provided by the system. It is a primary construct that can stand alone but is often connected to Actors or other Use Cases.
An Actor represents a role played by an external entity that interacts with the system. It is a primary construct that can also stand alone but is typically linked to Use Cases.
An Association relationship between an Actor and a Use Case, showing that the Actor interacts with or participates in the Use Case.
An Include relationship indicates that a Use Case explicitly incorporates the behavior of another Use Case.
An Extend relationship indicates that the behavior of a Use Case can be optionally extended by the behavior of another Use Case.
A Generalization relationship between two Actors, where one Actor inherits the role and responsibilities of another Actor.
A Generalization relationship between Use Cases, indicating that one Use Case is a special type of another Use Case.
